specialAbilities.name: Prescience
specialAbilities.notes: Player chooses which single field to demand before both plans lock.

specialAbilities.name: Kwisatz Haderach
specialAbilities.notes: Threshold is losses-taken, not losses-inflicted. Confirm exact number against GF9 rulebook.

aiWeighting.notes: Should avoid committing to battles where prescience hasn't been used. Prefers fewer, better-informed fights over volume.

specialAbilities.name: Extra Traitor Card
specialAbilities.notes: Standard traitor hand is 3; Harkonnen draws 4 and keeps as many as the rules permit. Confirm keep-count against rulebook.

aiWeighting.notes: Card advantage rewards large decisive battles. Should bid aggressively to deny cards even without intent to use them.

specialAbilities.name: Sardaukar Elevated Combat Value
specialAbilities.notes: Confirm exact per-force strength value against rulebook.

aiWeighting.notes: Should avoid early aggression. Spice reserves compound the longer bidding phases go uncontested by Emperor directly.

specialAbilities.name: Fremen Victory Condition
specialAbilities.notes: Trigger condition (turn count / stronghold state) needs confirming against rulebook before implementing as a hard check.

aiWeighting.notes: Should deliberately avoid looking like the leading faction early. Long-game oriented; threat level to others should stay artificially suppressed in its own self-assessment until late turns.

specialAbilities.name: Act at Any Point in Shipment/Movement
specialAbilities.notes: Guild chooses when in the phase order to act rather than following standard sequence.

specialAbilities.name: Guild Alternate Victory
specialAbilities.notes: Confirm exact trigger turn against rulebook.

aiWeighting.notes: Rational Guild avoids initiating conflict; wants the game to run long and wants every faction to keep needing its shipping lane.

specialAbilities.name: Peaceful Coexistence
specialAbilities.notes: Single advisor-status leader only, per rulebook. Confirm force limit.

specialAbilities.name: Prediction Victory
specialAbilities.notes: Private faction + turn guess made at setup, hidden from all other players and normally from the AI's own general decision layer too.

aiWeighting.notes: Real objective often invisible to the rest of the table. Passive/defensive play is frequently correct and should not be 'corrected' toward aggression.
